text: nice!! can u make sure that it doesnt always export to just texture.png because i dont want to overwrite others if i can avoid it. make it export by the name of the scene or somehting
resolution: Export filenames no longer default to texture.png (which silently overwrote prior exports). Two changes to exportSprite in Studio.tsx: (1) the base name is now the SCENE/model name — StudioViewport gained a sceneName prop wired from model.modelName — falling back to the dialog texture name, then 'texture', all sanitized to [a-z0-9_-]. (2) Before writing, it probes exists() and appends a numeric suffix (_1, _2, …) until it finds a free filename, so a repeat export of the same scene writes <scene>_1.png rather than clobbering <scene>.png; slices follow the same rule as <scene>_face<N>[_k].png. Files still land in cart/hmsc-int/exports/. textureize 9/9, Studio + sources bundle clean. Hot-reload TSX, nothing committed (user leads commits).
